reviews.title: DO NOT TRAVEL with this airline
reviews.text: I’ve had the worst experience of my life traveling with this flight. All airlines allow 46KGs checked but they only had $30Kg which was kind of hidden in their baggage guidelines. I ended up paying as much as the price of the ticket after moving around weight and stuffing my cabin with as much stuff as I could. This was at the airport. The payment counter/person was at a different location. Reminded me of a government office where they give a letter from one counter and then you have to go to a different counter for payment. They were giving discount of $7 for cash payment. My total bill amount was approx. ($248 for 7kgs). The flight was delayed, the in flight service was horrible. They ask you what you want first and serve you and then tell you to PAY even for a basic black tea. No charging slots, uncomfortable seats, unclean toilets. Moving on, Kuwait layover is like getting glimpse of hell on earth. I’d rather wait in toilet of any other airport than on this airport. Zero organization, I was allowed at the gate 20mins before my flight was scheduled to take off, apparently they don’t follow any schedule. It’s free will here coz the boarding hasn’t even started up until the scheduled departure for no particular reason. Couldn’t wait to just get out of the flight and head home. Worst 9-10hrs of my life after having an amazing trip to Istanbul. I wish this upon no one! Pay a little extra and find a better airline because they’ll make you pay one way or the other anyway! reviews.title: Direct flight to Tashkent
reviews.text: Jazeera airways has a Direct flight to Tashkent (Night flight). I have booked for the Economy extra with Premium Seat (Seat Rows 1 – 3) with Priority service. The Instructions on boarding are in Arabic, English & Russian. J Café is on air, with Sandwiches & Wraps. Kuwait to Tashkent: - The terminal was crowded. The T5 Pearl Lounge: - Small and stuffy The priority service was not efficient, I had to queue with all economy passengers in our way to the shuttle service. The bus was fully packed leading to the aircraft. Although my luggage was tagged with priority labels, my 2 suitcases were not the first on the luggage belt, upon arrival. I received my ordered Turkey sandwich with chips and 2 drinks (water & fizzy) upon boarding. The premium seat was leather made and it was comfortable with a very good legroom. Staff were friendly and hospitable Tashkent to Kuwait: - I received my ordered halloumi sandwich upon boarding, it was very soft and tasty Staff provided great service onboard. We Arrived on time. By the way, ground staff advised on, NOT booking for priority service back home, because all passengers were transit and usually only a handful (6 passengers) were departing the aircraft, hence luggage will be quick to receive. reviews.title: Smooth travel, clean Aircraft, very good cabin crew. On time flights.
reviews.text: My flights was from Bombay to Antalya via Kuwait. Transit time was 2.5 hours and everything was smooth. The flight took off on time at 4 am and we reached antalya via kuwait on time. Baggage was intact and received at Antalya airport. While returning as well from Antalya-kuwait-bombay the flight was on time and smooth. The entire journey was smooth. I didn’t buy any meals on plane but asked for water to the crew and they gave me water bottles twice with a smile. The pilots flew the aircraft really well without any issues. 5 stars for my first travel with Jazeera.
